response.overview: On the day of their wedding photoshoot, Da-hee (27/F) suddenly vanishes.  Plunged into despair, Yujun (27/M) clings to their brief, precious memories, like choosing flowers and rings. He becomes obsessed with photography, desperate to hold onto these fading moments.  However, Yujun realizes that it is more important to be faithful to his emotions in the 'now,' rather than clinging to material records of the past.  Yujun takes their wedding photos once again. Facing Da-hee as she gazes into the camera, he finally offers the heartfelt farewell and earnest proposal he was unable to convey before.  Although her image gradually blurs in his memory, he continues to remember her.
response.title: Ember : Of Memory and Meaning
